primary_dataset: Allen Visual Coding Neuropixels; original M0 frozen58session/332probe inventory
primary_protocol: functional_connectivity; chosen prospectively from metadata coverage, not neural scores
no_final_partition_assignment: Only assess potential. Do not launch M1 or access neural outcomes. Later authorized protocol must independently freeze identities and trial partitions.
source_policy: Reuse old hashed inventory; resolve official AllenSDK and ecephys processing source commits once; preserve exact source/docs/license receipts. Same frozen NWB ETags and raw S3 object identifiers. New metadata projection hashes supplement, never replace old M0.
permitted_access: Official processing, synchronization, histology, CCF and stimulus documentation/source code
Raw object sizes, version/ETag and native file format headers; no spike_band.dat or lfp_band.dat samples
Non-neural raw sync.h5 /meta and /data hardware sample-counter/digital-barcode-bit evidence, ONLY after authoritative schema validation; no analog data or behavioral bit interpretation
Probe event_timestamps.npy and channel_states.npy digital synchronization edges ONLY after official barcode/edge semantics verification; no sorted spikes arrays
NWB root/probe/device/electrode group structural attributes and timing/anatomy metadata; no unit/processing neural array values
NWB stimulus presentation start_time/stop_time/stimulus_block/stimulus_index/frame/orientation/temporal_frequency/contrast fields and interval tags/index; no behavioral responses
Invalid interval start_time/stop_time/tags/tags_index to identify probe-specific known exclusions
Server-projected anatomical coordinates, channel position, unit-channel-probe IDs and histology asset provenance only
forbidden: Behavioral outcomes or analog running/pupil values

transport.policy: Capped streaming; reject bulk NWB response; enforce ETag and Content-Range; reject soft/external HDF links. Save allowed digital timing evidence and decoded metadata, not opaque NWB payloads.

native_support_verification: Require authoritative channel stride/dtype, native clock origin, sampling/recording length, event-to-session transformation and gap/continuity evidence. Bare file length or absence of invalid flags is not full continuity proof. Report inferred serialized duration separately from certified observation.
clock_procedure: Use pinned official barcode definitions; validate parser and affine clock mapping against controlled digital fixtures and independent algebra; use all identifiable sync codes, no favorable subset. Report mismatches, splitting, residuals and extrapolation. Freeze exact decoder parameters/acceptance before digital timing decoding once source definitions are known.
trial_procedure: Identify repetitions by stimulus condition/block/frame progression; group complete movie frame cycles as trials, never frames. Prefer drifting_gratings_75_repeats and complete natural_movie_one_more_repeats if available. Audit interval validity, matched-subfield support and known exclusions. No trial-count scientific threshold invented; report actual independent repeated presentations for future registration.
anatomy_procedure: All unit-to-channel-to-probe-to-CCF mappings, atlas coordinates and independent histology provenance assessed separately. Quantify missing coordinates and proximity to within-probe label transitions at20/40um as metadata-only sensitivity, not anatomical certainty. Never equate peak-channel registration with independent histology.
warning_policy: Critical: undefined time bases, unknown observation origin/envelope or insufficient paired mice. Sensitivity: atlas-boundary/registration uncertainty if honestly scoped to annotated subfields. Optional: behavior covariates may be omitted in a prospectively stimulus-controlled analysis. Full original admission still requires its unchanged support standard.
stopping: One complete Allen audit. Never reclassify original M0. IBL existing inventory only if a specific documented blocker is realistically addressed there; otherwise no IBL acquisition. Stop before M1 regardless of verdict.
tests: Saved-metadata parity and actual native PowerShell
